# Astro portfolio starter attribution

The portfolio hero component, palette and rounded-navigation CSS are adapted from the MIT-licensed [Astro Portfolio Starter](https://github.com/withastro/astro/tree/main/examples/portfolio), inspected 16 November 2026. The complete upstream license is preserved in `astro-portfolio.LICENSE`.

Source fingerprints used:

- `src/components/Hero.astro`: blob `30460420aca533b784995ffede79a9fcb856448b` (adapted component).
- `src/components/Nav.astro`: blob `0b11c07f5992b0a60985fecdbfb83d8a60ce0c38` (rounded navigation styles adapted; navigation remains usable without JavaScript).
- `src/styles/global.css`: blob `d2657afc9dbd847481472d58d0281a0b6bb3e808` (light palette, shadow and layout utilities adapted).

Visual reference supplied by the owner: https://aitortita.com/. Its personal copy, portrait and project assets are not included. The portrait used here was already present in this repository. Background shading is CSS, without copied reference-site image assets. No template example projects, testimonials, technology wall or theme-switching runtime were imported.
